people.name: Euphrates
people.line: Major river in ancient Near East; boundary of Promised Land

translations.web: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.
translations.bsb: May he rule from sea to sea, and from the Euphrates to the ends of the earth.
translations.kjv: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.
translations.asv: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, And from the River unto the ends of the earth.
